PV Performance Benchmarking Africa Dataset
	


	
		
		Abstract
	

This dataset contains performance measurements and environmental data from grid-connected photovoltaic (PV) systems across multiple African countries. The data was collected to evaluate the influence of long-term and short-term solar radiation variability on PV performance under different technologies and climatic conditions.
